listings.title: Sunflower Embroidered Shirt, Hand Embroidered Neckline Tee, Oversized Cotton Floral T-Shirt, Cottagecore Gift for Her
description: Sunflower embroidered shirt with eight hand-stitched sunflowers hanging from the neckline on thin green stems, like a necklace you never take off. Hand embroidered on a heavyweight 220 GSM cotton oversized tee, not printed and not machine embroidered.
What it is

Sunflower Necklace is a garland of eight sunflowers strung from shoulder to shoulder around the collar, each one tilted at its own angle. Every flower is stitched by hand by our women artisans in Bulandshahr, India, so you can see and feel the raised petals.
Choose white for a soft, sunny look, or black to make the yellow petals glow.
Details
• Embroidery: looped lazy daisy petals in golden yellow, basket-weave brown centres, olive-green stem-stitch stems with small looped leaves
• Placement: around the neckline, shoulder to shoulder
• Fabric: 220 GSM heavyweight cotton
• Fit: oversized, drop shoulder, unisex crew neck
• Colours: white or black
• Sizes: XS to XXL (size chart in the photos)
Sizing
Order your usual size for the relaxed oversized fit, or one size down for a closer, regular fit.
Made to order
Your tee is hand embroidered after you order (about 7 to 10 days), then shipped with tracking.
Care
Hand wash cold and inside out. Dry flat in the shade. Never iron directly over the petals.
Why hand embroidery
A print fades and a machine repeats itself. Each sunflower here is stitched one by one, so no two shirts are exactly alike.
A happy gift for sunflower lovers, gardeners, and anyone who likes their florals with a little texture.

listings.shopify_title: Taanka Kantha Hand-Embroidered Oversized T-Shirt, White
listings.title: Kantha Stitch T-Shirt, Hand Embroidered White Tee, Minimalist Running Stitch Top, Oversized Cotton Boho Shirt, Slow Fashion
description: Kantha stitch t-shirt where the stitches are the design: rows of hand running stitch across the chest of a white 220 GSM cotton oversized tee, a warm brown herringbone band, and a blanket-stitched collar. We call it Taanka, Hindi for a single stitch.
What it is
A minimalist tee built from three classic hand stitches, made by our women artisans in Bulandshahr, India:
• Kantha running stitch: blue and brick-red dashes around a solid navy line
• Herringbone band: chunky crossed stitches in warm brown, like a woven border
• Blanket-stitched collar: light blue spokes all around the neckline
What is kantha?
A running-stitch embroidery tradition from Bengal, first used to layer old saris into quilts. Its signature is the plain dashed line.
Details
• Fabric: 220 GSM heavyweight cotton, less see-through than a thin white tee
• Fit: oversized, drop shoulder, unisex crew neck
• Colour: white
• Sizes: XS to XXL (size chart in the photos)
Sizing
Order your usual size for the relaxed oversized fit, or one size down for a closer, regular fit.
Made to order
Your tee is hand embroidered after you order (about 7 to 10 days), then shipped with tracking.
Care
Wash cold and dry flat. Keep the iron off the embroidery.
Why hand embroidery
A print fades and a machine repeats itself. Every dash here is a single stitch made by hand, so no two shirts are exactly alike.
A quiet, textured basic for anyone who loves slow fashion, visible stitching and handmade details.
notes: Leads with 'Kantha Stitch T-Shirt' instead of 'Taanka': shoppers search kantha, not the product name. Kantha results on Etsy are mostly jackets around $60, so there is little direct competition for a kantha tee.

listings.title: Floral Embroidered Hat, Hand Embroidered Yellow Flower Denim Cap, Acid Wash Baseball Cap, Garden Lover Gift for Her
description: Floral embroidered hat with sprays of small yellow blossoms hand stitched down the crown of a charcoal acid-wash denim cap, falling the way amaltas (the golden shower tree) drops its flowers in May.
What it is

Each flower is a cluster of detached chain-stitch petals with a rust-orange French knot at the centre. The stems are green chain stitch with small pointed leaves, and closed buds sit between the open blooms, so the spray reads as a real branch rather than a repeated motif.

The sprays run straight over the panel seams. A machine cannot do that on a finished cap: the hoop has to come off and the needle has to cross the join by hand, which is why the flowers flow across the front instead of stopping at each seam.
Details
• Cap: charcoal acid-wash denim, six panel, curved peak
• Embroidery: yellow blossom sprays across the crown and front panels; detached chain petals, French knot centres, chain-stitch stems
• Size: adjustable back, one size fits most
• Hand embroidered by our artisans in Bulandshahr, India
Made to order
Your cap is hand embroidered after you order (about 7 to 10 days), then shipped with tracking.
Care
Hand wash cold. Do not wring the embroidered panels. Air dry out of direct sun. Iron on the reverse only and keep the plate off the stitches.
A sunny gift for gardeners, flower lovers, and anyone who wants a cap nobody else has.
notes: Priced a little above your other caps ($29) because it is hand stitched across the seams; floral embroidered caps on Etsy cluster around $29 to $41.
